registered_at: 2026-10-23, before any script, feature or outcome
batch: untested-categories 2026-10-23 (operator: 'I want to test all of these')
study: Intraday periodicity (Heston, Korajczyk & Sadka 2010, J. Finance): a stock's return in a given half-hour slot predicts its return in the SAME slot on following days (lags of 1-40 days), strongest in the first and last half hours.
source: Heston, Korajczyk, Sadka (2010): 13 half-hour intervals; positive continuation at daily lags (13, 26, ... intervals) for at least 40 days; not explained by volume, imbalance, volatility or spreads. Out of sample (Chen et al. 2024) UK and Brazil yes, China weak.
prior: LOW (~10%): known effect is a few bp per half hour, likely below 5 bp cost; tested for completeness.
data: Warehouse SIP 1-minute bars, 400 names per session; half-hour slot returns built from bar closes at :59/:29 (slot s = close of the slot's last bar / close of the previous slot's last bar - 1; slot 1 = 09:30 open to 09:59 close).
signal: For each name, slot s, day t: SIG = mean of that name's slot-s returns over the previous 20 sessions in which it is in the sample (needs >= 10). Each day and slot, LONG = the top decile of SIG among names with >= 10 history (at least 20 eligible names).
trade: Buy at the open of the slot's first bar, sell at the close of its last bar (30 minutes). Slots 2..13 (10:00-16:00); slot 1 (09:30) is information (opening noise).
primary: LIFT = top-decile slot return minus the equal-weight mean slot return of all eligible names (same slot, same day); per day the mean over slots; day-equal; day-clustered t.
pass: In BOTH halves: LIFT >= +5 bp with t >= 2.0 AND top-decile mean net (after 5 bp) > 0.

common.halves: Warehouse studies: A = 2026-05-11 .. 2026-07-29, B = 2026-07-30 .. 2026-10-15 (110 sessions; 2026-04-27 .. 05-08 are warm-up for look-backs only).
common.statistic_default: Per half: per day, the mean over that day's trades of the measured quantity; day-equal mean; day-clustered t (df = days - 1).
common.cost: 5 bp round trip binding (the desk's current RT cost on $20+ names is ~3 bp); net also printed at 3, 10, 20 bp.
common.price_floor: entry price >= $10 primary; >= $20 (the desk's live floor) as information.
common.confirmation: A PASS is re-run unchanged on warehouse_confirm (2026-01-14 .. 04-24, held out, never read) before anything else; then a forward paper prereg. Never a desk change by itself; the desk stays frozen for the floor20 window.
common.power: Outcome-blind count step first: trades and days per half, and a projected MDE from the dispersion of the CONTROL leg only; floors per half >= 300 trades and >= 20 days, MDE <= the lift bar, else UNDERPOWERED with no outcome read.
common.fail_rule: FAIL: t <= -2 in a half, or the 97.5% upper bound of the lift below the bar in both halves. Otherwise not passed = UNDERPOWERED.
common.data_account: All fetches on the data-only Alpaca account (secrets_data.json), never the desk key; paced; no paid data.
common.multiplicity: Eight studies registered together on 2026-10-23 (the 'untested categories' batch). Each has ONE primary; a family-wise reading is printed: a primary counts as a batch PASS only with t >= 2.73 (Bonferroni 0.05/8, two-sided, normal approx) in both halves; t >= 2 in both halves without that is reported as 'PASS (single-test), not batch-robust'.
